proposition.claim:
Every R^i Gamma_rig(M) for every M in full H_k over finite k is pure under the definition requiring algebraic-integer eigenvalues.

k=F_2 finite perfect. K=K0=Q_2 complete with rational-rank-one value group. M=M(Spec F_2){1}=1(1)[2] lies in H_k because all integer twists are allowed. Witt Frobenius on Q_2 is identity. Exact monoidal realization pins 1(-1) to eigenvalue2, hence inverse twist to1/2.

Arbitrary lax fixed points are ordinary comodules over product_n t^n, using the comonadic argument.

C=D(Q), usual derived tensor: stable,presentable,Q-linear,compactly generated. t=Q[0] compact,Alt2(t)=0. T=id preserves colimits and products. X=direct sum Qe_j and S(e_j)=e_(j+1) are allowed arbitrary-operator data.

Rational polarizable mixed Hodge category is semisimple; F^p V intersect conjugate(F^q V) vanishes whenever p+q differs from pure weight.

E_Q=Qe0+Qe1; W below-2 zero, W_-2 through-1=Qe1, W>=0=E. F>=1=0,F0=C(e0+i e1),F<=-1=E_C. Weight graded pieces are polarizable types(-1,-1) and(0,0).

repair.content:
Replace algebraic integer by nonzero algebraic number with all complex absolute values q^(w/2). Tate twist shifts weight by -2r. Different-weight spectra are disjoint, so Hom=0; equal finite Q_p dimensions in the two-term complex then give Ext1=0.

Retain coalgebras for actual comonad G, not ordinary internal comodules over its value at1; completion alternative unverified.

Use hdim1 and weight-direction Hom/Ext vanishing in graded-polarizable MHS, pure fixed-weight semisimplicity. For pure weightn use V_C=F^p directsum conjugate(F^(n-p+1)); define intersection Hodge summands on p+q=n only.
